_comment: Sync-only tsconfig. package-build.mjs reads compilerOptions.paths from THIS file (it does not follow `extends`), so the aliases are inlined rather than inherited.
_ordering: The resolver walks `paths` in key order and accepts the first hit, testing the bare stem before any /index candidate. A bare stem that is a directory therefore wins, so every directory-style specifier must be pinned to its index file ABOVE the `@/*` wildcard. Only value imports are listed: the `@/lib/server/*` directories are imported as types only, are erased before resolution, and are deliberately left unmapped so a future value import fails loudly instead of pulling Postgres into a browser bundle.
_shims: next/link, next/image and next/navigation point at browser stand-ins: the real modules read the App Router context, which no rendered design has.
